heading: Thursday, August 13, 2026
topLine: Buzzard's team releases the Annals Challenge: 50 recent Annals theorems stated in Lean. Also: 2 model releases: Google Gemini 3.7 Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Pro (GA).

items.headline: Buzzard's team releases the Annals Challenge: 50 recent Annals theorems stated in Lean
items.summary: Kevin Buzzard's group at Imperial, funded by Renaissance Philanthropy, published Lean statements of 50 important theorems from 2020s Annals of Mathematics papers and added many new definitions to Mathlib. They challenge humans to formalize more statements and AI systems to autoformalize the proofs. Writing the statements in Lean has already found missing hypotheses in four papers by Fields Medallists.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash arrived three weeks after 3.6 Flash and targets coding and agents. Google reports 65.3% on DeepSWE v1.1, up from 49.0% for 3.6 Flash. Introductory pricing is $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through the end of 2026.

items.headline: DeepSeek makes DeepSeek-V4-Pro generally available
items.summary: DeepSeek released the general-availability version of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with agent-focused upgrades and adjustable reasoning effort for V4-Pro and V4-Flash. The release also added OpenAI Responses API support and peak/off-peak API pricing.
